answer: Students from outside the EU and the EEA are permitted to work 140 full days or 280 half days per year [1]. Working more than this allowed amount requires approval from the Federal Employment Agency and the foreigners' office [1].

citations.title: Working while studying
citations.passage: Students from outside the EU and the EEA may work 140 full days or 280 half days per year. Working more than that needs approval from the Federal Employment Agency (Agentur für Arbeit) and the foreigners' office (Ausländerbehörde). Self-employed or freelance work needs permission from the foreigners' office. Breaking these rules can lead to losing the right to stay.
